# Folder: .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE

## Role

This directory stores templates for creating new issues on GitHub. When a user creates a new issue, they can choose from these templates.

## File Breakdown

-   `bug_report.md`: The template for reporting a bug. It includes sections for describing the bug, how to reproduce it, and the expected behavior.
-   `feature_request.md`: The template for requesting a new feature. It includes sections for describing the problem and the desired solution.

## AI Reading Guide

-   This folder is for repository management and contribution guidelines. It does not contain application source code.
-   The content of these files is primarily for guiding users who are creating issues on GitHub.
